summary: Round 1 had no findings, so there was nothing to re-check. Since round 1 (ef500de..5215951) the only code change is tests/ci/sweep-shards.test.ts. It adds unit tests for invalid weights (-1, NaN, '5') and a test that the sequencer defaults to the committed tools/ci/sweep-weights.json, which it loads with a static JSON import. The test uses fixed fake paths and has no fs, shell, network or env input. The rest is doit bookkeeping (changes.md, build-log, gate JSON, state.json). The workflow, sweep-shards.ts, the weights file and the sandbox are unchanged, so the round-1 analysis still stands: matrix expressions are static literals, permissions stay contents: read, there are no new actions or dependencies and no secrets. No reachable security issues.
